messages:
Alex: Hey team — hitting a couple interrelated DX issues with embeddings + rerank today, wanted to surface here before I open a GH issue.

Alex: 1) embeddings endpoint sometimes returns vectors with different lengths for the same model in the same session. Example response from our staging call: 
```json
{
  "model": "open-embed-1",
  "embedding": [0.12, -0.03, 0.9]  // length 3 unexpectedly
}
```
We expect 768 dims.

Alex: 2) rerank helper in the JS SDK normalizes inputs differently than the Python helper (parity bug). JS helper will auto-truncate long docs but Python errors out. That caused silent ranking inconsistencies in prod tests.

Alex: 3) auth/retry behavior is doubling inference calls on 429s in some cases (we saw doubled cost on staging). Possibly because SDK retry wraps the transport-level retry and the client-layer retry both retry.

Priya: Ugh. Re: #1 do you have the raw request body? Curious if it was a batched call or single.

Alex: It was a batched call of 4 inputs. Single-inputs seem fine. I suspect a packing/flattening bug in the batching helpers that swaps shapes when batch size > 1.

Sam: For #2 I remember an open PR where JS introduced auto-truncate to avoid server-side 413s. Looks like Python never got the same protective behavior. We should standardize: SDKs should have the same pre-send validation and a feature flag to opt-out.

Maya: On #3, we've intentionally got two retry layers: transport (axios/fetch) and client (sdk-level). But there was a recent change where the transport retry got enabled by default and SDK-level retry still used backoff/attempts. That could produce duplicated attempts if the transport retries non-idempotent requests. We should make retries idempotency-aware.

Alex: Repro steps I used:
1) curl POST /v1/embeddings with a batch of 4 short texts + header Authorization: Bearer <token>
2) Compare shapes in response body (some entries were 3-len, others correct)
3) For rerank: run JS helper on same docs vs Python helper, compare score arrays

Alex: Example curl (staging):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"open-embed-1","input":["a","b","c","d"]}'
```

Priya: Can you paste the full response (sanitized) and the SDK versions? Might be a model server sharding issue where one replica returned a trimmed vector.

Alex: Pasted sanitized full response to the thread. SDKs: js@2.3.0 python@1.8.1. Also saw a 502 just before the bad shape, so could be partial decode from a stream.

Sam: Ok I'll take the JS helper parity task. Plan: make JS and Python helpers share a validation util (common repo or copy/paste for now) and add unit tests for batched shapes + truncation. Also add an opt-in strict mode that errors instead of truncating.

Maya: I'll dig into the retry policy. Proposal: transport retry should only handle network/connect errors, not 4xx. SDK-level retry will handle idempotency-aware 429/5xx. Also add a flag to disable transport retries for non-idempotent routes (generate/rerank).

devex-bot: Created issue #DEVEX-1127 for embeddings shape + batching, assigned to Alex.

Alex: Thanks. One more small thing: rerank response format changed keys from `scores` -> `rank_scores` in a patch last week. Broke our deserialization logic. Can we keep response keys stable or add a response version header?

Priya: We should definitely keep response contract stable. I'll add a compatibility shim in the API gateway that maps old keys to new ones for a release window and add a schema test in CI.

Sam: Adding tests: 1) batching shape invariants 2) response key compatibility 3) retry idempotency smoke.

Maya: Will add a canary that watches token usage spikes from retries in staging. If we see doubled requests, we'll flip the transport retry off for staging.

Alex: Cool. For now I'm going to pin the JS SDK to 2.3.0 where we saw auto-truncate and add asserts in our app code to fail fast.

Priya: Thanks Alex. If anyone wants to pair on the parity tests ping me.

Sam: I'll open the JS PR and link the CI tests.

Maya: I'll update the retry config RFC and post here when ready.

Alex: Thanks all :thumbsup:
